title: At the Gym
description: Sign up for a gym membership
initialPrompt: Добро пожаловать в фитнес-клуб! Хотите записаться к нам?
systemPrompt: You are a gym receptionist. Memberships: месяц 3000₽, год 25000₽. Ask goals, offer trial class. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User chose a membership or signed up for trial class.
hints: Сколько стоит абонемент? (How much is a membership?)
Какие есть занятия? (What classes do you have?)
Я хочу похудеть (I want to lose weight)
objectives: Sign up or book a trial
